caption: The drawing shows an ornate interior scene centered around a large window with a wooden frame, draped with patterned reddish-brown curtains that are tied back. In front of the window, there is a tiered black metal plant stand filled with pots of various colorful flowering plants, including reds, pinks, purples, blues, and whites, with additional green potted plants placed on the floor below the window. Two smaller potted plants are mounted on the wall to either side of the window. On each side of the composition, there is a green upholstered chair with gold fringe along the bottom edge, placed on a wooden floor. The wall behind the window and chairs is decorated with vertically striped yellow and blue wallpaper that has a floral motif. Above the chairs, there are pairs of ornate gold wall sconces with white flowers. Each side of the wall also features a framed oval portrait of a person in profile set in an ornate gold frame, and below each, a rectangular framed picture is hung. At the very top of the wall, there is a blue frieze with a repeating floral pattern. The entire composition displays a blend of green, gold, brown, and floral pastel tones.
title: Conservatory Window with Flowers
